description: Rothco’s Multi-Tool is the ideal companion for outdoor enthusiasts, DIYers, and anyone who values practical, versatile tools on the go. With over 10 different tools built into one, this compact gadget is designed for a range of activities from camping and hiking to daily tasks. The top features needle nose and regular pliers, as well as wire cutters, while one side includes a serrated saw blade, Philips and flathead screwdrivers, and a straight-edge blade. On the opposite side, you'll find a bottle opener/can opener, large flat screwdriver, awl, and nail file. Designed for ease of use, each tool securely locks into place, and push buttons allow for easy closing after use. Crafted from durable polyester, plastic, aluminum, and stainless steel, the multi-tool offers long-lasting reliability. It comes with a carry pouch and belt loop, making it a must-have for anyone who appreciates convenience and preparedness.
